text: Based on Earth-observation evidence, approximately 2.23% of the property was affected by tree-cover loss in 2021. This corresponds to a loss area of 81.3 hectares out of the total asset area of 3643.5 hectares. The tree-cover loss was primarily in planted forest areas, with 68.1 hectares of planted species (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda) affected. Additionally, there was some loss in patches under 0.5 hectares, totaling 37.3 hectares, which was not counted as an event.
